title: cyclosorus aquatilis

This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
